# Far Slopes Bounty

*Bekk pays a Trail Watch bounty for 80 monsters of the Far Slopes, gnawers, boars and hogs alike. He will pay it again, any time.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Midbarium](../towns/midbarium_quests.md) |
| Category | Repeatable |
| Given by | [Bekk](../npcs/bekk_uskari.md) |
| Level | 31 |
| After | [The First Report](../quests/hask_the_first_report.md) |

## Objectives

- Defeat 80 Far Slopes monsters ([Cliff Gnawer](../monsters/cliff_gnawer.md), [Wild Boar](../monsters/wild_boar.md), [Scarred Boar](../monsters/scarred_boar.md), [Flint Hog](../monsters/flint_hog.md), [Iron Boar](../monsters/iron_boar.md))

## Rewards

- 20,000 EXP
- 620 mesos
- +20 standing with Midbarium

The first time you complete it instead: 26,000 EXP, 1,000 mesos, [Highland Salve](../items/highland_salve.md) x10, +15 standing with Midbarium, +30 standing with [Bekk](../npcs/bekk_uskari.md)
